title: The Phase Transition in Online PCA Depends on $n/d\log(d)$, not $n/d$
summary: High dimensional statistical theory has established the importance of constant aspect ratio, when the number of dimensions ($d$) and samples ($n$) satisfy $n,d\to\infty$ with $n/d\to γ\in(0,\infty)$, in understanding the limits of canonical estimation problems.
